newsitem.title: USA: Dime Bancorp CFO Sparks to resign March 1.
newsitem.headline: Dime Bancorp CFO Sparks to resign March 1.

text.p: Dime Bancorp Inc said Monday that David Sparks, its executive vice president and chief financial officer, is resigning effective March 1.
Dime, parent of Dime Savings Bank of New York, said Sparks is leaving to pursue a private business opportunity outside the thrift industry.

Sparks, 52, joined Dime in mid-1996 from CoreStates Financial Corp, where he was chief financial officer. He oversaw Dime's accounting and financial reporting, treasury, external affairs and investor relations and strategic planning departments.
Dime did not say who will replace Sparks.
